visualCharacteristics: White band, 4-column row (col-lg-3, wraps to 2 at sm, 1 at xs): three article cards (image, blue h3, paragraph, bold 'Read more' link) and a What's New panel (blue header bar, light-blue body with news title, date, summary, 'read more'). Image on top, blue h3, body paragraph, bold text 'Read more' link; no card border/shadow; 4-up grid column width.
contentPattern: Look-alike items (image, title, text, link) that flow and wrap responsively (4 -> 2 -> 1 columns).

rows: h3 title + description paragraph(s) + Read more link
blockStructure.notes: Article cards: one row per card (3).

usage: Grid of article/landing teasers: image, title, short description and a Read more link.
reuseGuidance: Use for image-topped teaser cards with a trailing text link. One row per card: cell 1 image, cell 2 heading + text + link. Grid flows 1 -> 2 -> auto-fit columns.
